mission.title: Hot Potato
mission.description: Keep the General's key out of the Merovingian's hands and get it to Niobe.

npc.say: Good luck to you, soldier. In war, we can only count on chaos, but I have a feeling that we'll meet again before this is over. Dismissed.
Tell Niobe I kept it safe for her! And I want to be there when she uses it! Can't have too much security these days.

phase.briefing: Warrior, the General requests your immediate presence. There's been an important development resulting from your retrieval of the missing key.

enter.say:
Code stream shows a bunch of commando programs in there.
Did you ever wonder what they do in their off hours?

talk.say:
The Machines have marked my forces for extermination, no doubt due to the role we played in recovering the key. This doesn't come as a surprise to me, but I thought you should be one of the first to know. I've studied the report of the operation to retrieve the key, and I commend you for your success in that crucial mission.
My commandos will be busy defending against the Machines, so Zion will have to take on more of the work against the Frenchman. In fact, his forces are right now trying desperately to capture the key. Tyndall will have more information for you.

done.say: Uh-oh, I smell trouble. We'd better see what else Tyndall has for us.

phase.briefing: {player}, we do have some trouble. It appears that the Merovingian has found out that we obtained the key from Silver, and is making a last bid to get it for himself. Merovingian programs and operatives are attacking our couriers throughout the city. We need you to help secure the key's transport route. I'm directing you to a cluster of the Frenchman's forces blocking the route. You've got to take them out as quickly as possible!

enter.say: I'm reading Mervs in there. Let's get to it.

objective.text: Kill all of the Merovingian forces

phase.briefing:
Well done, Warrior. We-- One moment.
{player}, our team transporting the key is under attack! Anome has been directing them personally, but they've been ambushed by a group of Merovingians. We can't let the Frenchman get the key! Get to Anome's location and get the key out of danger!

enter.say: Anome's in there. I've got redpills and Exiles showing in my scan. This could be a little hairy--but what else is new when Anome's around?

done.say: No more Mervs left showing on my scanner. Now we need to get the key from Anome.

talk.say:
Took your damn time, didn't you? Those freaks nearly got me. I mean, I killed, like, thirty of 'em, but there's only so much one amazing fighter can do, you know?
Oh, the key. Right. Uh... I don't suppose you'd-- No, no, never mind. Some other time... Here, go ahead and take it.

done.say: The key's in that package. Let's get that hot potato outside before more Mervs show.

phase.briefing:
Good work, operative. I'm so glad you managed to save the key...and Anome too, I suppose.
It's up to you to get that key to Captain Niobe now, Warrior. Zion is counting on you!

enter.say: I'm scanning our troops in there... Looks quiet.

talk.say:
You made it! I'll be damned. Zion owes you one, operative.
Now, let me see that key.

done.say:
Good. Thanks again, operative; I won't forget this.
If you see Anome, tell him to get his butt over here. We're gonna have to open the General's case as soon as possible, before anything else comes along to interrupt us again.

mission.finish:
{player}, both the Machines and the Merovingian were after that key, but you still managed to return it to Niobe safely. It's...quite a feat, and I just want to say that I'm honored to be able to work with you.
The contents of the case are still unknown, but it sounds like Niobe intends to open it shortly. I'll let you know as soon as there's a further development, Warrior.
